title: Degree Game for Special Regular Graphs
summary: For a given $d$-regular graph $G$, a Maker-Breaker degree game is played by two players who alternately claim previously unclaimed edges of $G$. In the standard variant, the goal of Maker is to maximize the maximum degree of their induced subgraph, while Breaker aims to minimize it, or equivalently, to guarantee a certain minimum degree in their own subgraph. A classic pairing strategy shows that Breaker can secure at least $\lfloor d/4 \rfloor$ edges at every vertex of any $d$-regular graph. Breaking this bound for general or even for specific classes of graphs has been a long-standing open…
